title: Inteligencias múltiples en la era de la Inteligencia Artificial: ¿amplificación pedagógica o sustitución cognitiva? Multiple intelligences in the AI era: pedagogical amplification or cognitive substitution?
text_snippet: Inteligencias múltiples en la era de la Inteligencia Artificial: ¿amplificación pedagógica o sustitución cognitiva? Multiple intelligences in the AI era: pedagogical amplification or cognitive substitution? Howard Gardner's Theory of Multiple Intelligences (TIM) redefines intelligence as a diverse spectrum of abilities, challenging the unidimensional model based on IQ. In a world dominated by artificial intelligence (AI), this perspective gains critical relevance by questioning whether machines not only replicate but also transform our unique ways of thinking and learning. Accordingly, this essay argues that AI functions as a selective amplifier of multiple intelligences, particularly enhancing logical-mathematical and linguistic capacities while highlighting the irreplaceable human singularity in emotional, creative, and contextual dimensions, thus demanding a hybrid pedagogy capable of maximizing its educational potential. The central issue does not reside in the technology itself, but in the pedagogical principles guiding its application. Therefore, algorithmic use in educational settings must foster a balanced and dynamic environment that stimulates creativity, facilitates comprehensive understanding of curricular content, and enables identification of the most suitable learning approaches according to students' age and characteristics.

title: Conocimiento cultural étnico en educación primaria: una mirada desde la interculturalidad Ethnic cultural knowledge in primary education:an intercultural perspective
text_snippet: Conocimiento cultural étnico en educación primaria: una mirada desde la interculturalidad Ethnic cultural knowledge in primary education:an intercultural perspective The objective of this theoretical review article was to analyze ethnic cultural knowledge in primary education: an intercultural perspective. The methodology corresponds to a systematic literature review, using the PRISMA approach; search strategy of the PICO model (Population, Intervention, Comparison, Results); whose source of secondary information are databases, using the keyword search string, through the analysis-synthesis method, using the inclusion and exclusion criteria of the University of Melbourne. The findings showed that teaching from identity and ethnic knowledge in primary education strengthens learning, epistemic justice and the school-community link. Teacher training with an intercultural approach emerges as a key to overcome homogenizing practices and build inclusive classrooms. However, structural barriers persist that require institutional reforms and flexible policies to legitimize diversity as a pedagogical principle.

title: La lectura como estrategia mediada por la docencia y la dirección de trabajos de titulación: Un análisis sobre identidad profesional y constructo de desarrollo humano en estudiantes latinoamericanos Reading as a strategy mediated by teaching and the direction of thesis: An analysis of professional identity and the construct of human development in Latin American students
text_snippet: La lectura como estrategia mediada por la docencia y la dirección de trabajos de titulación: Un análisis sobre identidad profesional y constructo de desarrollo humano en estudiantes latinoamericanos Reading as a strategy mediated by teaching and the direction of thesis: An analysis of professional identity and the construct of human development in Latin American students This article analyzes the role of academic reading as a strategy mediated by teaching and thesis supervision in the construction of professional identity and human development among graduate students in Latin America. The sample includes 65 students from three master's programs: Education and Teaching, Healthcare Institution Administration, and Project Management. The research adopts a qualitative-descriptive approach using observation techniques, documentary analysis, and open-ended surveys. The results show that reading, when accompanied by effective pedagogical guidance, enhances critical thinking, research autonomy, and the consolidation of professional life projects.

The investigation carried out aimed to analyze how sustainable educational practices are articulated with the School Environmental Project (PRAE) from curricular, pedagogical, and environmental-territorial approaches with the aim of understanding trends, advances, and obstacles in environmental education. Seen from this perspective, this education is considered formal in the context of environmental education and is inscribed in the period 2021–2025. For this purpose, a documentary review was first carried out that used the historical-hermeneutic approach as a guide to develop a critical understanding of 56 normative and academic documents that were relevant in terms of their thematic relevance, topicality, and methodological rigor. The results allow us to highlight a change in paradigm in education, from an informative and behavioral vision that is still being realized from a critical, systemic and transformative perspective. title: La sanación como proceso de subjetivación: Espiritualidad católica, sufrimiento y salud mental en escenarios contemporáneos Healing as a process of subjectivation: Catholic spirituality, suffering, and mental health in contemporary settings
text_snippet: La sanación como proceso de subjetivación: Espiritualidad católica, sufrimiento y salud mental en escenarios contemporáneos Healing as a process of subjectivation: Catholic spirituality, suffering, and mental health in contemporary settings This doctoral research in Social Studies of Religion examines how Catholic healing is configured in pilgrimage settings, within a context marked by a contemporary crisis of meaning, psychic suffering, and social acceleration. Through a case study of the Sanctuary of Our Lady of Hope (Soracá, Boyacá), and drawing on a poststructuralist approach that combines discourse analysis, ritual observation, and genealogical, archaeological, and cartographic methods, the study examines how patients/parishioners articulate illness, pain, and faith. The findings show that healing is not reducible to physical recovery, but constitutes an integral process of re-signifying suffering: bodily, emotional, spiritual, and communal. Practices such as prayer, mass, pilgrimage, and testimony foster relief and subjective transformation. The sanctuary is thus understood as a symbolic and relational apparatus that intervenes in how human fragility is confronted. These results broaden the understanding of mental health by incorporating the spiritual dimension, without replacing medical or psychological care. Using an open qualitative approach, techniques such as participant observation in the classroom, semi-structured interviews, and student surveys were employed, providing a broad and direct understanding of the pedagogical practices developed at the institution. Analysis of the information collected identified the prevalence of an active lecture-based pedagogical model, in which the teacher plays a central role in conducting the class. It was found that, in most cases, it is the teacher who defines the content, organizes the activities, and regulates participation times, thus setting a uniform pace for the entire group. However, there were also specific moments in which student participation was incorporated through questions, dynamics, or audiovisual resources, suggesting the presence of elements characteristic of an active model, although subordinate to a mainly directive structure. title: Relevancia del conocimiento cultural nicaragüense en estudiantes de undécimo grado
text_snippet: Relevancia del conocimiento cultural nicaragüense en estudiantes de undécimo grado Introduction: Knowledge of Nicaraguan culture is an essential component in the comprehensive education of secondary school students; however, there has been evidence of limited mastery of traditions, customs, and cultural identity among students, which affects their sense of belonging and appreciation of national heritage. Methods: The research was conducted using a qualitative and descriptive approach, applied to eleventh-grade students in the city of Estelí during the first semester of the 2024 academic year. The sample consisted of 19 students selected based on common characteristics related to low participation in cultural activities. Data collection techniques included written and oral interviews, observation, and focus groups, the results of which were organized and analyzed through thematic categorization and triangulation of information. Results: The findings revealed that most students have limited knowledge of Nicaraguan culture, associating it with isolated and superficial elements. Influential factors identified include limited cultural transmission in the family environment, limited promotion in schools, and low use of media and digital platforms for cultural purposes.

text_snippet: Estudios sobre la práctica pastoral universitaria: una aproximación desde la metodología cualitativa de mapas de empatía Studies on university pastoral practice: an approach from the qualitative methodology of empathy maps The purpose of this article is to develop two approaches: the first, related to the understanding of empathy maps as a qualitative research methodology, and the second, an analytical approach concerning the results derived from them. These approaches will allow us to identify prospects and possibilities for university pastoral studies. The article is structured in four fundamental parts that allow a comprehensive understanding of the study: the theoretical and methodological references of the research; the second part addresses the relevance in relation to the understanding and scope of empathy maps as a qualitative research methodology; the third part presents the results, findings, and respective analyses of the empathy maps; and finally, the fourth part presents prospects regarding the possibilities that empathy maps offer for the study of university practices (pastoral laboratory).

title: La transdisciplinariedad en la escuela: una ética del cuidado frente a la complejidad educativa Transdisciplinarity in school: an ethics of care in the face of educational complexity

It argues that transdisciplinarity is not merely an epistemological or methodological approach, but rather an ethical practice of care that redefines pedagogical work. Its conceptual foundations are analyzed, distinguishing it from multidisciplinarity and interdisciplinarity, while highlighting its potential to reconnect diverse forms of knowledge. Likewise, its role in teacher education is examined, where active methodologies become concrete expressions of a transdisciplinary praxis. Finally, it is argued that transdisciplinarity constitutes a transformative horizon for Latin American schools insofar as it transcends the traditional logic of educational systems toward a humanizing, critical, and sustainable education, always oriented to the care of life. title: Educación socioemocional para la infancia y adolescencia en situación de institucionalización: ¿un derecho por cubrir? Socioemotional education by institutionalized children’s: a right to be covered?
text_snippet: Educación socioemocional para la infancia y adolescencia en situación de institucionalización: ¿un derecho por cubrir? Socioemotional education by institutionalized children’s: a right to be covered? Social-emotional learning (SEL) is an innovative process through which social and emotional skills are acquired, fostering holistic development. As an educational process, it is part of the right to education established by the Convention on the Rights of the Child. However, the population group made up of children and adolescents living in social assistance centers has limited access to this type of educational process as they grow up isolated from their community and family system. This raises the question of who is responsible for ensuring that this group has access to it. This study presents a reflection based on relevant literature, aiming to address these questions. It concludes that socio-emotional education for children and adolescents in institutional care is a right that must be guaranteed by the state. To achieve this, practices for the care and monitoring of this population must be improved, in addition to the implementation of governance strategies to coordinate the contributions of different sectors. Furthermore, social-emotional learning processes must be integrated into public policies aimed at protecting the rights of children and adolescents.

text_snippet: Necesidades formativas en materia pedagógica de docentes de danza de bachillerato Training needs in pedagogical matters in high school dance teachers Introducción: This research topic arises from a personal need to recognize and reflect on a process from two perspectives: my educational field (Bachelor's Degree in Contemporary Dance) and the professional field (teaching dance within the National Education System); as a Bachelor's Degree in Contemporary Dance, my objective was to develop my artistic career, mainly as a stage performer and choreographer, and, on the other hand, a precarious and unstable economy as a dancer led me to seek a balance in dance teaching. In my experience, teaching dance became a space to identify my gaps in knowledge regarding education, teaching, and understanding of what I should do, structure, or adjust to teach my subject. This led me to pursue a second degree in pedagogy, which allowed me to identify theoretical and methodological resources supported by theoretical approaches. This enabled me to engage with the educational phenomenon not only as a teacher in front of a group of students but also as a dance professional who can understand, analyze, evaluate, diagnose, and investigate educational processes. title: El saber pedagógico en la educación rural: la tecnología y la inteligencia artificial como factores de inequidad. Pedagogical knowledge in rural education: technology and artificial intelligence as factors of inequality
text_snippet: El saber pedagógico en la educación rural: la tecnología y la inteligencia artificial como factores de inequidad. Pedagogical knowledge in rural education: technology and artificial intelligence as factors of inequality Identifying educational opportunities for educators is a challenge in remote rural areas, and the emergence of Artificial Intelligence (AI) presents new challenges. The importance of digitally literate teachers is becoming a necessity, given that students are demonstrating greater agility in using these tools, while their capacity for analysis and critical thinking is limited in some cases. This article reflects on the analysis of the evident educational gap between public institutions in urban contexts and public institutions in rural areas. Furthermore, the article highlights the importance of access to new technologies in educational communities and how these advances can support educational processes or further limit school needs. In this sense, one of the main challenges in rural education is precisely the lack of technological infrastructure, which implies a critical and reflective approach that can problematize the absences in the territory and the effects on the learning of the school population in these contexts.

title: Inteligencia artificial y educación: reflexiones e interrogantes Artificial intelligence and education: reflections and questions
text_snippet: Inteligencia artificial y educación: reflexiones e interrogantes Artificial intelligence and education: reflections and questions This writing presents reflections on artificial intelligence and Education. It analyses five topics that have implications for both university teaching and learning. Emerging aspects of AI that can be problematic, didactic–pedagogical biases and risks of AI in education, teaching and academic integrity, and critical spirit and AI. The analysis of each topic is approached from a humanistic perspective and with a well-founded forward-looking vision, which allows for contrasting one`s own opinions with those of other authors. From the proposed analysis in each topic, a series of questions are presented as conclusions aiming to generate ideas or inquiries that lead to a deeper exploration on affectivity and emotional management and its relation to AI.

title: Ética e inteligencia artificial en la educación: innovación educativa y gobernanza en Hispanoamérica Ethics and Artificial Intelligence in Education: educational Innovation and Governance in Latin America
text_snippet: Ética e inteligencia artificial en la educación: innovación educativa y gobernanza en Hispanoamérica Ethics and Artificial Intelligence in Education: educational Innovation and Governance in Latin America Introduction: The advent of artificial intelligence (AI) has precipitated a structural shift in teaching and management models in Hispano-America, moving from peripheral digitization to a profound reconfiguration of the educational act. The objective is to analyze the ethical dilemmas and innovation opportunities arising from this technological integration. Methods: A qualitative design was used based on a systematic literature review (SLR) following PRISMA protocols and the SALSA framework. Articles from Scopus and Web of Science published between 2018 and 2026 were analyzed, using iterative thematic coding to identify dimensions of governance, equity, and privacy. Results: Findings highlight AI's potential for massive personalization through adaptive systems and the optimization of teaching work. However, critical risks emerge such as algorithmic bias, decision-making opacity, student data privacy violations, and the academic integrity crisis caused by generative AI. Conclusions: AI should act as a complementary human-centered tool, not a substitute for teacher judgment. title: Simuladores virtuales en la formación de cirugía laparoscópica: una nueva era de aprendizaje Virtual simulators in laparoscopic surgery training: a new era of learning
text_snippet: Simuladores virtuales en la formación de cirugía laparoscópica: una nueva era de aprendizaje Virtual simulators in laparoscopic surgery training: a new era of learning Laparoscopic surgery has become one of the most widely used techniques in contemporary surgical practice, thanks to its widely recognized benefits, such as reduced invasiveness, faster recovery, and lower rates of postoperative complications. In this context, virtual simulators emerge as a key pedagogical tool to transform learning in minimally invasive surgery, allowing residents and students to practice complex procedures in controlled and realistic environments without risks to real patients. These technologies optimize the limited surgical resources available by shifting part of the training from the operating room where time and materials are constrained to an accessible and repeatable virtual space, accelerating the acquisition of technical skills such as intracorporeal suturing or instrument manipulation. The authors consider virtual simulation to be an invaluable opportunity to innovate in the teaching of laparoscopic surgery, improve patient safety by minimizing initial errors in the operating room, and optimize learning processes through immediate feedback and objective performance metrics.

title: Lectura crítica en la era de la Inteligencia Artificial Generativa, potencialidades y riesgos en la escuela Critical Reading in the Era of Generative Artificial Intelligence: Potentials and Risks in School
text_snippet: Lectura crítica en la era de la Inteligencia Artificial Generativa, potencialidades y riesgos en la escuela Critical Reading in the Era of Generative Artificial Intelligence: Potentials and Risks in School Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) is undeniably disrupting the educational landscape, especially in teaching and learning processes. This incursion raises a significant debate about the impact of applying this new technology in primary and secondary education settings. In this context, the concern arises to analyze the influence and relevance of GAI as a pedagogical strategy and tool within the reading and writing processes of young people, with an emphasis on critical reading. This article reflects on the potential benefits and risks of these tools in learning critical reading, as well as the pedagogical transformations necessary to integrate them meaningfully. From a critical perspective, it is argued that GAI can strengthen students' reading comprehension and metacognitive skills, provided there is conscious and ethical mediation within the teaching and learning process of these new technologies. Finally, the need to rethink the concept of critical reading in the digital age and to guarantee democratic conditions that ensure access to generative artificial intelligence (GAI) for the entire educational community is discussed.

title: La Bildung en la época de la Inteligencia Artificial The Bildung in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
text_snippet: La Bildung en la época de la Inteligencia Artificial The Bildung in the Age of Artificial Intelligence This article seeks to explore, from the perspective of the philosophy of education, the implications that the mass dissemination of artificial intelligence may have on the educational concept of Bildung. To do this, we will first clarify the general features of Bildung. We will then connect it with the invention of artificial intelligence to answer the following (interrelated) questions: Has artificial intelligence rendered the concept of Bildung obsolete? Do we need to look for other things, perhaps new paradigms? Or can this German concept, coined in the 18th century, still tell us something relevant about education and pedagogy?

title: Análisis del aprendizaje de las unidades de medida desde un enfoque físico-matemático en estudiantes de física matemática de la UNAN-Managua/CUR-Estelí. The study conducted an in-depth analysis of the students' learning of the fundamental units of measurement (mass, length, and time). This research arose from the need to identify, through a standardized diagnostic test, the conceptual learning difficulties and obstacles that students present on the subject. The main purpose was to evaluate learning levels using statistical tools and methods, through measures of central tendency and dispersion by group, comparing the level of knowledge in units of measurement among students and determining the percentage difference through the dispersion in the test results. The study worked with a representative sample of students from different years of the program. title: Pensamiento crítico de frontera e inteligencia artificial: una mirada ética, epistemológica y pedagógica desde el Sur global Critical thinking at the frontier and artificial intelligence: an ethical, epistemological and pedagogical perspective from the Global South
text_snippet: Pensamiento crítico de frontera e inteligencia artificial: una mirada ética, epistemológica y pedagógica desde el Sur global Critical thinking at the frontier and artificial intelligence: an ethical, epistemological and pedagogical perspective from the Global South This article proposes a reflection on critical thinking and its relationship with artificial intelligence (AI) in educational contexts, from a situated, ethical, and decolonial perspective. Through theoretical analysis and argumentative reconstruction, it identifies the tensions between critical and technical rationalities, highlighting the role of epistemologies of the Global South in the redefinition of critical thinking. The category of “critical border thinking” is introduced as an alternative that allows for reading and resisting the epistemic control mechanisms that accompany the uncritical deployment of AI in school systems. Furthermore, it problematizes the educational, ethical, and technological gaps in Colombian schools and proposes pedagogical criteria aimed at a critical appropriation of AI as an emancipatory tool. The article concludes by proposing a critical pedagogy of AI use, based on epistemic justice, digital discernment, and the strengthening of teacher and student agency. title: The impact of artificial intelligence on education and learning processes El impacto de la inteligencia artificial en la educación y los procesos de aprendizaje
text_snippet: The impact of artificial intelligence on education and learning processes El impacto de la inteligencia artificial en la educación y los procesos de aprendizaje This paper aims to analyze the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on modern education and learning processes, both from a theoretical and empirical perspective. The first part discusses the essence of AI, its definitions, main types, and the key opportunities and risks associated with its implementation across various areas of social life. Particular attention is given to education as a space for technological adaptation and the development of innovative teaching methods. The second chapter examines the influence of AI on the education system, highlighting its dual role as both a challenge and an opportunity for teachers, students, and educational institutions. Various applications of AI technologies in teaching are presented, including intelligent tutoring systems, personalized learning tools, and automated assessment solutions. The role of educational theory in the design of machine learning algorithms is also discussed, along with a brief historical overview of AI's development and integration into educational environments. title: La Inteligencia Artificial en la investigación científica: una revisión doctrinal sobre las potencialidades de uso, riesgos y límites Artificial Intelligence in scientific research:a theoretical review of its potential applications, risks, and limitations
text_snippet: La Inteligencia Artificial en la investigación científica: una revisión doctrinal sobre las potencialidades de uso, riesgos y límites Artificial Intelligence in scientific research:a theoretical review of its potential applications, risks, and limitations In previous research, we observed that technological development, first with the Internet and then with Artificial Intelligence (AI), has enabled substantial advances in the research process, but also significant risks affecting research authorship and research ethics. Universities face major challenges: this new reality cannot be ignored; technological advancement can contribute to faculty development and student training, enabling improved research. Faculty training is essential to transmit this knowledge to students. It also presents a problem of enormous magnitude, as the AI ​​system based on ChatGPT allows researchers to create works whose authorship is attributed to the machine. The ethical limits posed by this new technology, the problems of plagiarism, and the difficulty in detecting it, present the dilemma of either accepting this new reality, introducing limits on its use, or prohibiting it altogether. This study analyzes 23 articles that aim to confirm previous findings on the potential, limitations, and risks of AI in scientific research. The results indicate that the sample supports the use of AI with limitations.

text_snippet: El uso de la inteligencia artificial en el aula de clase como apoyo a los procesos de aprendizaje en básica primaria, secundaria y media The Use of Artificial Intelligence in the Classroom as Support for Learning Processes in Primary, Secondary, and Middle Education La emergencia de nuevas tecnologías en la información y la comunicación ha posibilitado múltiples escenarios educativos que pueden impactar de forma positiva los aprendizajes. En los diferentes niveles educativos, el uso y aplicación de IA puede ser útil en la enseñanza, el saber y el aprendizaje. title: Las redes sociales en estudiantes adolescentes: retos y paradigmas en educación Social media among teenage students challenges and paradigms in education
text_snippet: Las redes sociales en estudiantes adolescentes: retos y paradigmas en educación Social media among teenage students challenges and paradigms in education This paper is a documentary study for the purpose of analyze the benefits and risks associated with the use of digital platforms and social media in relation to academic performance in adolescent students. By better understanding these factors, pedagogical strategies could be proposed on an ad hoc basis to enable teachers and education policymakers to maximize their use and mitigate their adverse effects. Previous studies have presented both the challenges and advantages of their use, for which it is crucial to identify how they can be constructively integrated into the educational environment. Among the strategies proposed to boost higher academic performance, in addition to foster adequate mental health and well-being among adolescents who use the digital environment on a daily basis, are: the implementation of psychoeducational interventions designed to raise awareness among adolescents about the negative effects and the promotion of healthy habits, training in responsible use, digit

title: Impacto del uso de teléfonos móviles en el desarrollo social integral de los adolescentes en zonas rurales Impact of cell phone use on the comprehensive social development of adolescents in rural areas
text_snippet: Impacto del uso de teléfonos móviles en el desarrollo social integral de los adolescentes en zonas rurales Impact of cell phone use on the comprehensive social development of adolescents in rural areas The purpose of this study was to evaluate the impact of cell phone use on the comprehensive social development of adolescents in rural areas. The methodology used in this study was descriptive design, qualitative approach and interpretative paradigm; a non-probabilistic sample of 10 adolescents from the Daraili community was used, and the techniques employed included interview and observation. The results obtained reveal that adolescents consider cell phones as essential tools for their daily life, using them mainly for communication and entertainment; however, it was identified that the excessive use of these devices has negatively affected their interpersonal relationships and their participation in community activities, which has generated a reduction in interaction directly with other people. In conclusion, the excessive use of cell phones affects the development of their social relationships and community participation of adolescents; although they are more digitally connected, interactions in person have decreased. title: La Razón Pedagógica: un neologismo con carga semántica propia para resignificar la formación docente The Pedagogical Reason: A Conceptual Neologism for Rethinking Teacher Training
text_snippet: La Razón Pedagógica: un neologismo con carga semántica propia para resignificar la formación docente The Pedagogical Reason: A Conceptual Neologism for Rethinking Teacher Training This paper proposes and supports the concept of Pedagogical Reason as a neologism with its own semantic load, emerging from the need to name a form of situated, ethical, and transformative rationality specific to the pedagogical field. Unlike traditional categories such as technical, practical, or critical reason, Pedagogical Reason is configured as an epistemic logic that arises from pedagogical knowledge itself, articulating ontological, practical, and political dimensions of educational action. Drawing on philosophical and pedagogical references such as Aristotle, Gadamer, Freire, Carr, Kemmis, Perrenoud, Flecha, and Quiceno, it is argued that this neologism not only fills a conceptual void but also provides an interpretative framework for understanding and reframing teacher education processes in Latin America. It is demonstrated that this construct cannot be replaced without loss of meaning, as it integrates a network of meanings that reclaim the teacher as an epistemic, historical, and ethical subject. title: Las tecnologías emergentes y su impacto en la formación del profesorado hispanoamericano: lecciones aprendidas de las experiencias asiáticas Emerging technologies and their impact on Hispanic American teacher education: lessons learned from Asian experiences
text_snippet: Las tecnologías emergentes y su impacto en la formación del profesorado hispanoamericano: lecciones aprendidas de las experiencias asiáticas Emerging technologies and their impact on Hispanic American teacher education: lessons learned from Asian experiences In Hispanic America, teacher training faces significant challenges, such as the digital divide and the lack of focus on technological skills. The disparity in technology integration in Hispanic American educational institutions reflects the need for comprehensive strategies. This article examines lessons learned from Asian experiences, where countries such as Singapore and China have led the way in the adoption of emerging technologies. The Asian experiences highlight the importance of adaptability and flexibility in the implementation of technologies. They also highlight the need to involve all stakeholders, including teachers, students, and parents, to ensure the success of technology integration. Strategies to overcome resistance, such as mentoring programs and continuous training, are transferable to Hispanic American contexts. When considering applicability in Hispanic America, key aspects such as adaptability of technology platforms, personalization of learning, and effective teacher training are identified. title: Análisis de Estrategias Discursivas y Dinámicas Interactivas entre Estudiantes en un Aula de Secundaria en México Analysis of Discourses Strategies and Interactive Dynamics among Students in a Secondary School Classroom in Mexico
text_snippet: Análisis de Estrategias Discursivas y Dinámicas Interactivas entre Estudiantes en un Aula de Secundaria en México Analysis of Discourses Strategies and Interactive Dynamics among Students in a Secondary School Classroom in Mexico This study analyzes the interactions of 20 secondary school students in a mathematics class at a public school in Chihuahua, Mexico, as they solve trigonometric problem. Discourse strategies and interactive dynamics within the teams were identified and their impact on problem-solving was assessed through a qualitative case study approach. Strategies such as seeking clarity, error correction, and planning were observed, which appear to facilitate the structuring of thought and collaboration in the search of solutions. Additionally, collaboration dynamics and active debate enriched the learning process by promoting joint reflection.Variation in participation ant the use of analogies also emerged as relevant elements, suggesting that equitable distribution of roles and the use or discourse resources like analogies can enhance mathematical understanding. The study suggests that promoting interaction in the mathematics classroom could benefit student performance and comprehension in this context, although these findings should not be generalized to other settings without further research.

title: Conceptos y enfoques en el área de la gestión de competencias Concepts and approaches in the area of competency management
text_snippet: Conceptos y enfoques en el área de la gestión de competencias Concepts and approaches in the area of competency management In the context of dynamic changes caused by globalization and technological progress, competency management is becoming a key element of organizational strategies. This study aimed to diagnose the concepts and approaches of researchers in the field of competency management, especially about construction companies in the Piła region. The main study was conducted using the survey method. The literature and survey results were analyzed to identify approaches to competency management and their effectiveness in implementing the strategies of enterprises. The research revealed that only 36% of the surveyed enterprises actively support the development of competencies, and 52% use strategic human resources management. Only 28% of these organizations use effective intellectual capital management systems. Obstacles in the implementation of competency management systems result from insufficient investments and the lack of an organized approach to the development of human resources. The need to create an environment conducive to learning and to better adapt the strategy to changing market needs was indicated. title: Los alumnos con necesidades educativas especiales como parte de la inclusión en las aulas Students with special educational needs as part of inclusion in classrooms
text_snippet: Los alumnos con necesidades educativas especiales como parte de la inclusión en las aulas Students with special educational needs as part of inclusion in classrooms There is currently a need for personalized educational attention for students with special educational needs. It is essential to respect diverse learning paces and provide sufficient resources to foster genuine inclusion in the classroom. Practical teacher training in universities, along with the need for continuous and committed teacher development, is key to adequately addressing this situation. Inclusive education must be a model that benefits all students, promoting values such as empathy, respect, and solidarity. Inclusion is not only a pedagogical issue, but also an ethical and social one, aimed at building a more equitable society.

text_snippet: Evolución de los documentos relacionados con el uso de la Inteligencia Artificial en el área de Educación Física Evolution of the documents related to the use of the Artificial Intelligence in the area of Physical Education Artificial Intelligence is understood as the set of computer algorithms that are used to make technology similar to human intelligence. In addition, it enables everyday actions such as learning, reasoning and problem solving. In the field of education, Artificial Intelligence is of great importance, as it allows teachers to give immediate feedback, personalise learning, predict results and improve digital competences. Therefore, due to the importance and benefits of integrating Artificial Intelligence in the educational field, it is essential to initiate different reviews to analyse its use. The aim of the present study was to develop a bibliometric review related to the use of Artificial Intelligence in the area of Physical Education. The Web of Science database was used, using the search phrase: "Artificial Intelligence" and "Physical Education", obtaining a total of 108 valid documents. The results show the great growth of this subject, with a 55% increase in the last 6 years. title: Praxeología de la educación: Análisis de los avances educativos en el último gobierno de Guatemala Praxeology of Education: An Analysis of Educational Progress in the Last Government of Guatemala from a Classical Liberal Perspective
text_snippet: Praxeología de la educación: Análisis de los avances educativos en el último gobierno de Guatemala Praxeology of Education: An Analysis of Educational Progress in the Last Government of Guatemala from a Classical Liberal Perspective This article examines the educational progress in Guatemala during the 2020–2023 government period from a praxeological and classical liberal perspective. Using an analytical-descriptive methodological approach, it evaluates the structural challenges of the educational system, particularly at the secondary level within the public sector. Recurring issues are identified, including poor financial planning, corruption, unequal distribution of resources, and lack of accountability. Through official statistics, interviews with educational stakeholders, and document analysis, the article highlights the contradiction between political discourse centered on “social justice” and the operational reality of the Guatemalan education system. The praxeological analysis allows these phenomena to be interpreted as distortions in the logic of institutional human action, where the means employed do not align with the declared ends. From a classical liberal standpoint, it is argued that truly liberating education must focus on the development of individual rationality, autonomy, and critical thinking, moving away from ideological indoctrination and state monopoly.
